Usage: agentcage cage exec [OPTIONS] NAME COMMAND...

  Run a command inside a cage container.

  Example:
    agentcage cage exec --as-root myapp -- openclaw devices list

Options:
  -s, --service [cage|egress]  Container service to exec into.  [default: cage]
  --as-root                    Run the command as root (uid 0) instead of the
                               workload's uid 1000 user (debug only).
  --help                       Show this message and exit.
